title: fleet-guards: provider-API failure (USED=0 invalid-observation) silently disables waste alarm + burn marker
description: Codereview of 2ehk (correctness+security passes, kimi-k3). total_used() prints 0 on any OpenRouter credits-API failure (fleet-guards.sh:52); fleet_burn.py returns {"evaluated": false, "reason": "invalid-observation"} (fleet_burn.py:62-65) without touching the baseline. The shell extracts only evaluated, discards reason, and treats it as the normal mid-window case — no WARN, every cycle, forever if the outage is permanent (rotated key, endpoint change). In that state the waste alarm AND the $2000 burn marker (fleet-guards.sh:116, same USED) are dead with zero signal; the stall canary won't catch it because bd is local. Fix: WARN when reason == "invalid-observation" specifically (NOT on reason presence — baseline-established also carries a reason), e.g. extract reason like evaluated. Severity P2: same silent-death class (lh2z, $720/8h) the guards exist to prevent.
close_reason: FIXED: fleet-guards.sh waste-alarm hunk now (1) extracts reason from the fleet_burn.py JSON alongside evaluated (W_REASON), (2) latches one bd P1 alarm per provider-outage episode when reason==invalid-observation, gated on flag $REPO/.fleet-provider-obs (mirrors the .fleet-waste-helper pattern — silent WARN-per-cycle would be the log-only death class these guards exist to prevent, lh2z), and (3) clears the latch on the first valid observation via a != guard placed at the top of the healthy-parse else branch, so empty/PARSE_FAIL helper cycles can neither fire nor clear the latch. Warns ONLY on invalid-observation specifically — baseline-established/reestablished-clock/mid-window/rolled (all imply used>0, verified fleet_burn.py:88-96) pass through silently. New regression guard scripts/test_fleet_guards_provider_obs.py: structural invariants on the shell hunk + an independent helper-contract test executing fleet_burn.update directly (0 -> invalid-observation + no baseline write; 10 -> baseline-established). Tests: 23/23 pass (2 new + 21 existing fleet suite); bash -n clean. 3x codereview ALL delegated to kimi-k3: correctness PASS; security PASS with one scope note — new latch repeats the flag-before-create pattern tracked in OPEN bead b4rd, comment filed there; edge-cases PASS (stale-flag self-heal, alternating episodes, same-cycle interplay, empty/PARSE_FAIL, absent-reason paths all verified). NOTE: closed with --force — store recorded this worker's claim as Mark Atwood but current actor resolves as opencode-worker-2.
